content: Event sourcing makes the event store the audit log and enables temporal queries and replay-through-fixed-logic debugging, but carries permeating architectural constraints: event-store schema design, projection rebuilds, schema evolution across millions of events, eventual consistency; not justified for most systems, best for finance/compliance/high-scale. Event sourcing records state changes but not everything attempted. You do NOT need event sourcing to have a complete audit log - a state column plus an append-only audit/event table gives auditability without the folding-to-derive-state cost. Recommended for Dark Factory: state columns are the source of truth for control flow; run_events is append-only observability, rich enough to narrate the run but never folded to compute where the run is.
